internal.title: Incident Report: High Latency in Ad Service Resolved
internal.body:
At 12:09 UTC on 2026-11-08, an alert was triggered for high latency in the ad service. Initial diagnosis confirmed elevated p95 latency close to 1 second and high CPU utilization. However, further analysis showed that resource exhaustion was not the root cause. The action taken was to disable the adHighCpu flag at 12:29 UTC, which led to recovery and normalization of latency metrics. The incident was resolved promptly with no lasting impact on service availability.

Timeline:
- 12:09:53: Alert received for high latency
- 12:29:33: Diagnosis round 1 and replanning
- 12:29:46: Flag adHighCpu disabled
- 12:29:46: Recovery verified with latency metrics returning to normal

Next steps include reviewing flag usage and monitoring CPU utilization trends to prevent recurrence.
